Maya (People Ops): Quick planning thread  - Priya is targeting parental leave starting 2026-10-04 (~12 weeks). Need decisions: backfill contractor vs internal shuffle, payroll top-up form timing, and what to do about the mid-cycle performance review.

Priya: Correct. I'll apply for FMLA this week. Plan to be offline first 8 weeks, then check email once/week. Will prepare a 1-pager handoff.

Devon (Eng): Team can absorb lower-priority work, but features will slip without extra headcount. Recommend contractor 0.5-1.0 FTE for 10-12 weeks. I can mentor vendor during first week.

Alex (Hiring): I can stand up a temp req. Need start/end dates + cost center. Also confirm hourly budget. Priya, can you provide acceptance criteria for handoff?

Priya: I'll add a checklist (deploy runbook, critical dashboards, oncall notes) tonight. Acceptance criteria: no blocked launches, and oncall coverage documented.

Maya (People Ops): Payroll note: to get Redwood supplement, sign Supplement Election by payroll cutoff 2026-09-15. Payroll-bot will send reminder 2 weeks before. Also, performance review scheduled for 2026-10-12 : suggestion to defer rating until return and add a deferred note. Thoughts?

Devon (Eng): Defer review rating, but schedule a short pre-leave calibration chat so we capture informal feedback. 30m should work.

Payroll-bot: Supplement Election form deadline for Priya: 2026-09-15. Request ID LR-20261004-09.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: Alex to post temp req by 2026-07-01; Devon to propose internal coverage plan by 2026-08-01; Priya to upload FMLA + handoff by 2026-09-01; People Ops to set review to "deferred" before 2026-10-12.

Priya: Thanks team. Will do the handoff doc tonight and confirm the dates.

Alex (Hiring): Posting req now (REQ-TEMP-4129).
